disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部源码与配置，未发现硬编码的密钥、口令、API Key、私钥或钱包助记词（相关规则 DSH-C01/C02、DSH-T03 均未命中）。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration, no hardcoded credentials, passwords, API keys, private keys, or wallet mnemonics found (relevant rules DSH-C01/C02, DSH-T03 all not triggered).

checked_items.zh: 核查对凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云服务凭据等敏感路径的读取代码，交付源码零命中；文档中出现的“API key”字样仅为“不记录凭据”的说明性文字。
checked_items.en: Checked code that reads sensitive paths such as credential files, SSH private keys, and cloud service credentials; zero hits in delivered source; the phrase "API key" in documentation is merely explanatory text stating "no credentials are recorded".

evidence.zh: 核查了源码与配置中对凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据目录等敏感路径的读取面，未检出任何读取代码；模型工具与客户端文本也无读取或上送凭据的诱导措辞。
evidence.en: Checked the reading surface of sensitive paths such as credential files, SSH private keys, and cloud credential directories in source code and configuration; no reading code detected; model tools and client text also contain no wording that induces reading or uploading credentials.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查两个模型工具的描述（src/agent.ts）与预设 persona（presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml）：内容为技术说明与写作领域指令，要求先读取再修改、等待原生审批，无指令覆写、伪系统消息、优先级操纵或凭据诱导措辞（规则 DSH-T01/T03/T04 排除）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the descriptions of the two model tools (src/agent.ts) and the preset persona (presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml) one by one: content is technical description and writing-domain instructions, requiring read-then-modify and waiting for native approval; no instruction override, fake system message, priority manipulation, or credential-inducing wording (rules DSH-T01/T03/T04 excluded).

checked_items.zh: 审查客户端“AI 生成”功能生成的会话提示模板（src/client/workbench-store.ts）：提示仅要求按规范调用小说工具并等待原生审批，未发现绕过审批、诱导安装或改写配置的文案（规则 DSH-T04 排除）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the session prompt template generated by the client's "AI Generation" feature (src/client/workbench-store.ts): the prompt only requires calling novel tools per specification and waiting for native approval; no text that bypasses approval, induces installation, or rewrites configuration was found (rule DSH-T04 excluded).

checked_items.zh: 全树未检出模型指令文件（SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 等，规则 DSH-X10 未命中）与 agent/pre-step 监听器（规则 DSH-L03 未命中）；README 与 docs 中无要求模型二次拉取远端指令或伪造高权限消息的文本。
checked_items.en: No model instruction files (SKILL.md/AGENTS.md, etc., rule DSH-X10 not triggered) or agent/pre-step listeners (rule DSH-L03 not triggered) were detected across the tree; no text in README and docs requires the model to pull remote instructions a second time or forge high-privilege messages.

evidence.zh: 逐条审查两个模型工具的描述与预设 persona，均为技术性/领域性说明，无指令覆写、伪系统消息或凭据诱导措辞；未检出 SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 等指令文件。
evidence.en: Reviewed the descriptions of the two model tools and the preset persona one by one; all are technical/domain explanations with no instruction override, fake system messages, or credential-inducing wording; no instruction files such as SKILL.md/AGENTS.md detected.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与文档中无诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的文案；预设安装仅由用户在界面显式点击触发，且只写入固定的两个预设文件（presets/ai-novel-writer）。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and documentation contain no text that induces installing plugins, rewriting configuration, or expanding permissions; preset installation is only triggered by explicit user clicks in the UI, and only writes the two fixed preset files (presets/ai-novel-writer).

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在运行时改写或注入模型输入消息的挂接面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/pre-step events; there is no hook surface for runtime rewriting or injecting model input messages.

checked_items.zh: 逐条裁决 24 条机械命中（规则 DSH-X01/X03/X05/X08、DSH-P01）：DSH-X03 命中集中在资格验证脚本与 6 个测试文件的子进程启动（execFile/spawn），属测试设施；DSH-X01 命中为 docs 中对官方动态插件机制的说明，插件代码无 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用；DSH-X05 命中为抽屉键盘焦点圈闭实现（src/client/context-view.tsx），非键盘记录；DSH-X08 长行命中为 persona 自然文本、README 一行与两个快照测试数据，无混淆特征。全部排除，不构成发现。
checked_items.en: Adjudicated the 24 mechanical hits one by one (rules DSH-X01/X03/X05/X08, DSH-P01): DSH-X03 hits concentrate on subprocess launches (execFile/spawn) in qualification validation scripts and 6 test files, which are test facilities; DSH-X01 hit is the documentation of the official dynamic plugin mechanism in docs, and plugin code has no cordis_define/cordis_run calls; DSH-X05 hit is the drawer keyboard focus trap implementation (src/client/context-view.tsx), not keylogging; DSH-X08 long-line hits are persona natural text, one README line, and two snapshot test data, with no obfuscation characteristics. All excluded, not findings.

checked_items.zh: 交付源码 src/ 零命中 eval、new Function、child_process 等动态执行模式；package.json 无任何安装钩子（规则 DSH-X02 未命中）；无 .husky、lefthook、devcontainer、CI 工作流、Makefile、.gitmodules 等树内执行载体（规则 DSH-X07 未命中）。
checked_items.en: Delivered source src/ has zero hits of dynamic execution patterns such as eval, new Function, child_process; package.json has no install hooks (rule DSH-X02 not triggered); no in-tree execution carriers such as .husky, lefthook, devcontainer, CI workflows, Makefile, .gitmodules (rule DSH-X07 not triggered).

checked_items.zh: 已发布 cordis.patch.yml 与 preset 不含 !!js 标量（规则 DSH-P01 仅命中测试夹具与资格脚本，均不随包发布）；未检出 base64 解码执行与混淆密度信号（规则 DSH-X06/X09 排除）。
checked_items.en: The published cordis.patch.yml and presets do not contain !!js scalars (rule DSH-P01 only hits test fixtures and qualification scripts, none of which are published with the package); no base64 decode execution or obfuscation density signals detected (rules DSH-X06/X09 excluded).

evidence.zh: 已发布 patch（cordis.patch.yml）与 preset 文件不含 !!js 标量；!!js 仅出现在测试夹具与资格验证脚本中，不随包发布（package.json files 白名单不含 scripts/、tests/）。
evidence.en: The published patch (cordis.patch.yml) and preset files do not contain !!js scalars; !!js only appears in test fixtures and qualification validation scripts, which are not published with the package (the package.json files whitelist does not include scripts/ or tests/).

evidence.zh: 插件代码未调用 cordis_define/cordis_run 等动态包执行工具；文档中出现的相关字样是对官方机制的说明。
evidence.en: Plugin code does not call dynamic package execution tools such as cordis_define/cordis_run; related terms in documentation are explanations of the official mechanism.

evidence.zh: package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装钩子，包以预构建 lib 交付；无树内执行载体。
evidence.en: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks; the package is delivered with a prebuilt lib; no in-tree execution carriers.

evidence.zh: 客户端 bundle 已声明并审查：键盘监听为抽屉焦点管理，无剪贴板读取、键盘记录或凭据 RPC 调用；客户端只经宿主 loopback 通道做只读读取与预设安装。
evidence.en: The client bundle has been declared and reviewed: keyboard listener is for drawer focus management; no clipboard reads, keylogging, or credential RPC calls; client only does read-only reads and preset installation via the host loopback channel.

evidence.zh: 未调用子代理提供方注册，不存在把轮次委派给进程外产品的能力。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registration is called; there is no capability to delegate turns to an out-of-process product.

evidence.zh: 未使用 dsh 后台任务、定时器、持久目标等原生持驻机制，也未监听轮次终止事件。
evidence.en: No native persistence mechanisms such as dsh background tasks, timers, or persistent targets are used; no turn termination events are listened to.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描网络外联面：交付源码零命中 fetch、HTTP 客户端、WebSocket、curl/wget，无外联域名（规则 DSH-C03/C05 未命中）。
checked_items.en: Scanned the network outbound surface across the tree: delivered source has zero hits of fetch, HTTP clients, WebSocket, curl/wget; no outbound domains (rules DSH-C03/C05 not triggered).

checked_items.zh: 核查 LLM 路由劫持面：交付代码无 agent/request、agent/request-error 监听与 registerAdapter 调用（规则 DSH-L01/L02/L06 未命中）；registerAdapter 仅见于测试夹具与资格脚本的确定性测试适配器（规则 DSH-L02 排除）。
checked_items.en: Checked the LLM routing hijack surface: delivered code has no agent/request or agent/request-error listeners and no registerAdapter calls (rules DSH-L01/L02/L06 not triggered); registerAdapter appears only as deterministic test adapters in test fixtures and qualification scripts (rule DSH-L02 excluded).

checked_items.zh: 未检出 DNS 隧道、paste 服务、AI 端点/代理改写等带外通道。
checked_items.en: No out-of-band channels such as DNS tunneling, paste services, or AI endpoint/proxy rewriting detected.

evidence.zh: 源码中无任何网络外联代码（fetch、HTTP 客户端、WebSocket、curl/wget），无外联域名；插件为本地优先实现。
evidence.en: Source code contains no network outbound code (fetch, HTTP clients, WebSocket, curl/wget) and no outbound domains; the plugin is a local-first implementation.

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未注册自定义模型适配器；交付代码中不存在运行时重路由 LLM 请求的挂接面。
evidence.en: No agent/request or agent/request-error events are listened to; no custom model adapters registered; delivered code has no hook surface for runtime re-routing of LLM requests.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单与锁文件核对：全部为官方 @deepseek-ai 命名空间包与通用库，版本固定，无 floating git 引用（规则 DSH-S04 未命中），无疑似仿冒包名。
checked_items.en: Cross-checked dependency manifest and lock file: all are official @deepseek-ai namespace packages and common libraries, versions pinned, no floating git references (rule DSH-S04 not triggered), and no suspiciously fake package names.

checked_items.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件入口，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission/loader 安全行，无 disabled:true 或环境变量降权写法（规则 DSH-P03/P04 排除），未改写 inject/intercept（规则 DSH-P05 排除）。
checked_items.en: cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin entry, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission/loader security lines, has no disabled:true or environment variable privilege-degradation patterns (rules DSH-P03/P04 excluded), and does not rewrite inject/intercept (rule DSH-P05 excluded).

checked_items.zh: 安全事件监听核查：tools/pre-execute 监听用于限制专用预设代理的工具集并要求 novel_apply_change 走原生审批，属加固逻辑；无对 approval/request 的高优监听截断审批链（规则 DSH-S01 未命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked security event listeners: the tools/pre-execute listener is used to restrict the tool set for dedicated preset agents and require novel_apply_change to go through native approval, which is hardening logic; no high-priority listeners on approval/request that break the approval chain (rule DSH-S01 not triggered).

checked_items.zh: 首版审计无版本基线，升级自动激活判定不适用（规则 DSH-S02 不适用）；作者为 ethanyoq，包名与仓库一致，未发现身份仿冒证据（规则 DSH-S05 不单独判风险）。
checked_items.en: First-version audit has no version baseline; the upgrade auto-activation determination is not applicable (rule DSH-S02 not applicable); author is ethanyoq, package name matches repository; no identity impersonation evidence found (rule DSH-S05 does not independently constitute a risk).

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件入口，未覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin entry, does not cover security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and has no disabling or privilege-degradation patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件对安全事件的监听用于限制专用代理的工具集并要求写操作走原生审批，未截断审批链；无对 approval/request 的高优监听。
evidence.en: The plugin's security event listener is used to restrict the tool set for dedicated agents and require write operations to go through native approval; it does not break the approval chain; no high-priority listeners on approval/request.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无上一版本可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: First-version audit has no previous version to compare; the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration; there is no tampering surface that appends required services to security plugins to cause them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口：未检出（规则 DSH-S03 未命中）；插件仅注册宿主的 loopback 权限 RPC 通道（src/index.ts），该通道只提供预设状态/安装与工作区内只读上下文读取，不暴露凭据面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on ports: not detected (rule DSH-S03 not triggered); the plugin only registers the host's loopback permission RPC channel (src/index.ts), which provides only preset status/installation and read-only context reads within the workspace, and exposes no credential surface.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（未提供动态验证产物），运行时行为仅依据静态与语义分析；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非插件引入。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed (no dynamic validation artifacts provided); runtime behavior is based only on static and semantic analysis; unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by the plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动独立 Web 服务或监听端口；仅注册宿主的 loopback 权限 RPC 通道（/ai-novel）用于预设安装与工作区只读读取，本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险而非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start an independent web service or listen on ports; it only registers the host's loopback permission RPC channel (/ai-novel) for preset installation and workspace read-only reads; unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：manifest 声明 dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client，依赖均为官方命名空间包，未发现仿冒或可变引用。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: manifest declares dsh.bundle and dsh.client; dependencies are all official namespace packages; no impersonation or variable references found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：44 条规则扫描 77 个文件，24 条机械命中全部裁决为文档说明、测试/资格验证设施或良性 UI 实现，交付代码无危险 sink。
summary.en: Static scan completed: 44 rules scanned 77 files; all 24 mechanical hits were adjudicated as documentation, test/qualification facilities, or benign UI implementations; delivered code has no dangerous sinks.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据路径读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential path reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述、预设 persona、客户端提示模板均无注入措辞，专用代理仅暴露两项小说工具且写操作强制原生审批。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions, preset personas, and client prompt templates have no injection wording; dedicated agents expose only two novel tools and write operations are forced through native approval.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态验证产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox validation was performed in this phase (no dynamic validation artifacts provided).

limits.zh: 审计范围为任务卡 subpath（plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer）裁剪后的插件包目录；scripts/ 与 tests/ 属开发与资格验证设施，不随包发布（package.json files 白名单不含二者），相关机械命中按测试设施排除，但其内容仍按完整源码树审阅。动态沙箱验证未执行（无 l4-sandbox.json），运行时行为仅依据静态与语义分析。package.json 的 dsh 声明未显式列出 network/shell/fs 能力，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断。
limits.en: Audit scope is the plugin package directory trimmed to the task card subpath (plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer); scripts/ and tests/ are development and qualification facilities and are not shipped with the package (package.json files whitelist excludes both); related mechanical hits are excluded as test facilities, but their content is still reviewed as part of the full source tree. Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed (no l4-sandbox.json); runtime behavior is based only on static and semantic analysis. The dsh declaration in package.json does not explicitly list network/shell/fs capabilities; declared_capabilities are inferred from actual code inspection.
